import json, time, random, importlib.util, resource, subprocess, sys
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def psize(obj, cap=20010):
    m.MAX_TUPLES = cap
    services = obj["services"]
    si = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(services)}
    atoms = m.collect_atoms(obj["rules"])
    mons = [m.build_monitor(op, p, si, len(services))[0] for op, p in atoms]
    res = m.build_product(mons, len(services))
    return (len(res[0]) if res else None)

rng = random.Random(31)
services = ["t%02d" % i for i in range(24)]
# search for conjunction-of-contains near 20000
best = None
for trial in range(40):
    natoms = rng.randint(8, 10)
    pats = [[rng.choice(services) for _ in range(rng.randint(10, 16))] for _ in range(natoms)]
    rules = [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "contains", "path": p} for p in pats]}}]
    obj = {"services": services, "rules": rules, "queries": []}
    ps = psize(obj)
    if ps and (best is None or ps > best[0]):
        best = (ps, obj)
print("best product size:", best[0])
obj = best[1]
obj["queries"] = [["t%02d" % i for i in range(24)]]
json.dump(obj, open("hard_case.json", "w"))
t0 = time.time()
res = m.compile_request(obj)
el = time.time() - t0
out = json.loads(res)
print("compile %.2fs, minimal states %d, out %d bytes, rss %d MiB" % (
    el, len(out["dfa"]["accept"]), len(res), resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss // 1024))
EOF
